title: 街路パーキングメーター
description: ソーラーパネル、表示部、投入スロット、操作ボタンを備えた独立型パーキングメーター。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Standalone parking payment meter with solar canopy, segmented display, coin slot, selection buttons, reader pad and rear service access. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
